Real-time Weather Monitoring.Temperature Range: Live temperature from 14°C–38°C depending on season. Best months: Nov–Feb for 13°C–28°C. Check IMD West Bengal portal daily.
Real-time Weather Monitoring.Humidity Level: Humidity ranges 60–92%. Below 75% is comfortable for outdoor activities. Above 85% = heat stress risk. Pre-monsoon May–Jun is worst.
Real-time Weather Monitoring.Rainfall Probability: Oct–Mar: near-zero rainfall chance. Jun–Sep: 70–90% daily rainfall probability. Apr & Oct are transitional – carry rain gear.
Real-time Weather Monitoring.Wind Conditions: Coastal winds 10–28 km/h. Jun–Sep: gusty 20–28 km/h (dangerous for boats). Nov–Feb: gentle 9–13 km/h – perfect.

7-Day Forecast.Source: India Meteorological Department (IMD) – imd.gov.in. Regional office at Kolkata updates data every 6 hours.
7-Day Forecast.Update Frequency: Major forecasts updated at 5:30 AM, 11:30 AM, and 5:30 PM IST daily. Cyclone bulletins issued every 3 hours when active.
7-Day Forecast.Coverage: All West Bengal coastal districts: East & West Medinipur, South 24 Parganas. Specific beach forecasts available for Digha and Mandarmani.
7-Day Forecast.Alerts: Cyclone alerts via National Disaster Management Authority (ndma.gov.in). SMS alerts: register on mausam.imd.gov.in for your location.

Storm & Cyclone Alerts.Alert Levels: 1–3 (Watch), 4–6 (Warning), 7–10 (Extreme). Signal 10 = evacuate immediately. Signal 4+ = cancel all beach plans.
Storm & Cyclone Alerts.Warning System: Colored signal flags at beaches: Green (safe), Yellow (caution), Red (no entry). Radio stations: Akashvani Kolkata 100.1 FM.
Storm & Cyclone Alerts.Emergency Contacts: National Emergency: 112 | Disaster Management: 1070 | West Bengal NDMA: 033-2214-5555 | Coastguard: 1554
Storm & Cyclone Alerts.Shelter Locations: Cyclone shelters at Digha: Digha High School, Purba Medinipur Municipality. Mandarmani: Contai Municipal Hall. GPS: share your location.

Cultural Attractions.Marine Aquarium: Digha Marine Aquarium, Sea Beach Road, Old Digha. Open 9 AM–5 PM. Entry ₹30 adults, ₹15 children. Exhibits: 100+ sea species.
Cultural Attractions.Chandaneswar Temple: 8 km from Digha toward Odisha border. Shiva temple, huge Shivratri fair. Free entry. Dress modestly. Open sunrise to sunset.
Cultural Attractions.Local Villages: Shankarpur fishing village, 14 km from Digha. Best time 5–7 AM for fish auction. Mandarmani: Muriganga village boat tours.
Cultural Attractions.Mangrove Interpretation Center: Sajnekhali, Sundarban. Free with forest permit. Displays on mangrove ecology, tiger behavior, local tribes. Open 9 AM–4 PM.

Spa & Wellness.Beach Resorts: Hotel Sea Hawk (Digha): full spa – massage, steam, sauna. ₹500–2000/session. Book 24 hrs ahead. Rose Valley Resort (Mandarmani): ayurvedic.
Spa & Wellness.Ayurvedic Centers: Keraleeyam Ayurveda, Contai Road, Digha. Kerala-style treatments ₹800–3000. Full body Abhyanga ₹1200. Open 8 AM–8 PM.
Spa & Wellness.Massage Centers: Multiple massage parlors on New Digha Beach Road. Thai massage ₹500/hr. Foot reflexology ₹300/30 min. Local oil massage ₹400/hr.
Spa & Wellness.Yoga Sessions: Morning yoga on Old Digha Beach: 6–7 AM. Free community sessions near Digha Mohana. Mandarmani: resort yoga ₹200/session.

Dining & Entertainment.Seafood Restaurants: Best: Hotel Sea Hawk, Bay View, Rupasi Bangla, Sonar Bangla. Order: Chingri Malaikari, Pomfret fry, Bhetki curry. Average ₹400–1000/person.
Dining & Entertainment.Local Cuisine: Must try: Shorshe Ilish, Chingri Malaikari, Kankra (crab) curry. Bengali sweets: Mishti Doi, Sandesh from Annapurna Sweets on New Digha road.
Dining & Entertainment.Beachside Cafes: Marine Drive walkway has 20+ beachside stalls. Bhelpuri, corn, coconut water, fresh lime soda. Best at evening around 5–8 PM sunset time.
Dining & Entertainment.Food Tours: Guided culinary tours: contact Digha Tourism (WB Tourism office) or book via MakeMyTrip. Half-day food walk ₹500/person includes 4 eateries.

Travel Insurance Options.Basic Coverage: ₹500/person. Covers: trip cancellation up to ₹10,000. Claim via insurer app. IFFCO Tokio, Tata AIG offer travel plans online.
Travel Insurance Options.Weather Shield: ₹800/person. Full refund if official cyclone warning (Signal 4+) issued. Includes accommodation costs. Apply on policybazaar.com.
Travel Insurance Options.Premium Protection: ₹1500/person. Comprehensive: cancellation + medical emergency (₹1 lakh) + baggage loss. Best for Sundarban multi-day trips.
Travel Insurance Options.Group Plans: 4+ travelers: 20% discount on all tiers. Family floater available. Contact HDFC ERGO or Bajaj Allianz for group policies.

Refundable Bookings.Free Cancellation: Book on Booking.com or MakeMyTrip with free cancellation filter. Most Digha hotels offer up to 24-hour free cancellation policy.
Refundable Bookings.Partial Refund: 50% refund if cancelled 48–72 hours before. 25% refund 24–48 hours before. Contact hotel directly for better terms during off-season.
Refundable Bookings.Weather Guarantee: Some resorts offer full refund if official NDMA cyclone warning issued. Ask specifically when booking. Rose Valley Mandarmani has this policy.
Refundable Bookings.Reschedule Policy: Free date changes with 72-hour notice. During peak season (Dec–Jan), reschedule fee may apply. WBTDC bookings: free reschedule anytime.

Alternative Date Suggestions.Peak Season: Nov–Feb: Best weather (13–28°C), zero rain, all activities available. Crowded and expensive but worth it. Book 2–3 months ahead.
Alternative Date Suggestions.Shoulder Season: Oct & Mar: Near-perfect weather, 10–30% lower prices, fewer tourists. March is best value – warm but not monsoon yet.
Alternative Date Suggestions.Off Season: Apr–Sep: 40–60% cheaper hotels, very few tourists but dangerous weather. Only experienced travelers should visit. Avoid Jun–Jul completely.
Alternative Date Suggestions.Best Value: November: Perfect balance – peak weather just starting, crowds not yet peak, prices mid-range. Ideal for first-time visitors.

Available Hotels.Budget Range: ₹800–1500/night: Hotel Digha International, Purba Medinipur Lodge. Clean rooms, basic amenities. Walk to beach 5–10 min. Book directly.
Available Hotels.Mid-Range: ₹2000–4000/night: Hotel Sea Hawk (3-star), Hotel Dolphin. AC rooms, restaurant included. Book on MakeMyTrip for best rates.
Available Hotels.Luxury: ₹5000–12000/night: Hotel Mondal (4-star beachfront), Rose Valley Mandarmani, Taj Coral (seasonal). Includes pool, spa, restaurant.
Available Hotels.Eco-Resorts: ₹3000–6000/night: Sajnekhali Tourist Lodge (Sundarban), Green Forest Resort (Mandarmani). Solar-powered, local food, wildlife focus.

Beachfront Properties.Hotel Sea Hawk: 4-star, Old Digha beachfront. Direct beach access. Restaurant, AC, parking. Book: +91-3220-266XXX or MakeMyTrip. ₹3000–6000/night.
Beachfront Properties.Sujata Beach Resort: Direct beach access, Mandarmani. Budget-friendly ₹1500–3000. Cottage-style rooms. Book direct for best rates.
Beachfront Properties.Rose Valley Resort: Luxury beachfront, Mandarmani. Pool, spa, multi-cuisine restaurant. ₹5000–12000/night. Book: rosevalleyhotels.com
Beachfront Properties.Sajnekhali Tourist Lodge: Inside Sundarban forest – unique experience. Forest dept property. ₹2000–4000 with meals. Book: wbtdcl.com (West Bengal Tourism).

Booking Platforms.Booking.com: Best for free cancellation and international card payment. Wide selection including small guesthouses. Filter by 'free cancellation' always.
Booking Platforms.MakeMyTrip: Best for India travel: combo train+hotel deals, EMI options, Indian payment methods. Good cashback offers. App preferred over website.
Booking Platforms.Direct Hotel: Call/email hotel directly for 5–15% lower rates than OTAs. Best for negotiating extras: airport pickup, early check-in, complimentary breakfast.
Booking Platforms.WBTDC: West Bengal Tourism official portal (wbtdcl.com). Books government tourist lodges at Sajnekhali, Digha. Fixed rates, reliable quality.

Train Options.Howrah-Digha: Tamralipta Express 12858: Howrah 6:40 AM → Digha 10:30 AM. Daily. 2nd class ₹75, Sleeper ₹185, AC ₹450. Book irctc.co.in.
Train Options.Howrah-Contai: Tamralipta 12858 or Kandari 18001. Get off at Contai (Kanthi). 3 hrs from Howrah. Then auto to Mandarmani (14 km, ₹150).
Train Options.Sealdah-Canning: Local EMU trains every 30 min from Sealdah platform 10–15. 1.5 hrs. Fare ₹25–35. From Canning, auto to Godkhali (45 min, ₹50).
Train Options.Cost Range: Unreserved: ₹50–75. Sleeper: ₹150–250. 3AC: ₹350–550. Book 60 days ahead for peak season. Tatkal quota opens 1 day before.

Bus Services.AC Volvo: ₹320/person. SBSTC Volvo: Esplanade → Digha. AC, comfortable seats. Departs 7 AM, 10 AM, 2 PM, 5 PM. Journey: 4 hrs.
Bus Services.Non-AC: ₹180/person. More frequent. Operates every 45–60 minutes from Esplanade Bus Stand, Kolkata. Last bus 8:30 PM. Arrives Digha ~5 hours.
Bus Services.Popular Lines: SBSTC (govt – safest), Greenline AC (private), WBTC. Avoid unknown private operators. SBSTC counter at Esplanade, Gate 3.
Bus Services.Travel Time: 4–5 hours in normal traffic. Add 1–2 hours on holidays and long weekends (Friday evening extremely congested). Start early.

Car Rental.Self-Drive: Zoomcar/Revv: ₹2500–3500/day including fuel. Book online. One-way drop available at extra cost. International license accepted.
Car Rental.With Driver: ₹3500–5000/day with hotel pickup. AC Sedan (Innova/Ertiga preferred for groups). Book via MakeMyTrip Cabs or local Kolkata travel agents.
Car Rental.Popular Routes: NH16 (Kolkata → Kolaghat → Contai → Digha). Best scenic: SH4 coastal road near Contai. Avoid NH16 on Fridays (heavy traffic).
Car Rental.Providers: Zoomcar, Revv (app-based self-drive). With driver: Meru Cabs, local agents near Park Street, Kolkata. Negotiate 2-day packages.

Essential Items.Sun Protection: SPF 50+ sunscreen (reapply every 2 hours). Wide-brim hat (covers neck). UV400 polarized sunglasses. Lip balm SPF 15+ for beach.
Essential Items.Swimwear: 2 swimsuits minimum (drying time). Beach rash guard for long sessions. Quick-dry towels. Waterproof bag for phone and wallet.
Essential Items.Footwear: Flip-flops for beach. Water shoes for rocky areas (Sundarban). Comfortable walking shoes for sightseeing. Avoid open sandals in forest.
Essential Items.Documents: Govt ID (Aadhaar preferred). Hotel booking confirmations (printed + digital). Forest permit (Sundarban). Travel insurance documents. Emergency contacts noted.

Clothing Suggestions.Day Wear: Light cotton kurtas or breathable t-shirts. Linen trousers or shorts. Light colors (white/beige) reflect heat. Avoid synthetic fabrics.
Clothing Suggestions.Evening Wear: Light jacket or cotton sweater for Nov–Feb (evenings 13–18°C). Wrap/shawl for ladies. Jeans fine for evenings. Closed shoes for restaurants.
Clothing Suggestions.Temple Visits: Shoulders and knees must be covered. Carry dupatta/stole. Remove footwear at temple entrance. Women: salwar kameez or saree preferred.
Clothing Suggestions.Forest Safari: Full-sleeve shirts and trousers (neutral colors: khaki, olive, grey). No bright colors – alert wildlife. Waterproof trekking shoes mandatory.

Health & Safety.First Aid: Bandages, antiseptic cream, pain relief (Paracetamol, Ibuprofen). Burn cream for sunburn. Electrolyte sachets for dehydration. Medical tape.
Health & Safety.Medications: Anti-diarrhea (ORS + Norfloxacin). Motion sickness (Avomine) for boat rides. Antacids. Antihistamine for insect bites. Carry prescriptions.
Health & Safety.Insect Protection: DEET 30%+ spray (Odomos, OFF!). Anti-malarial (Chloroquine or Doxycycline for Sundarban – consult doctor 2 weeks before). Permethrin for clothes.
Health & Safety.Water Purification: Drink only packaged mineral water (Bisleri, Aquafina). Avoid ice in non-hotel eateries. Boiled water at village homestays. Carry 2L/person/day.

Beach Activities.Swimming: Safe: Old Digha (lifeguards 6 AM–6 PM). Moderate: New Digha south end. Unsafe: Mandarmani (no lifeguards, undertow risk). Always check flags.
Beach Activities.Beach Buggy: Mandarmani only. Available 6 AM–6 PM. ₹300–500 per 20-minute ride. Best: sunrise sessions on the 13 km stretch. Book at resort reception.
Beach Activities.Jet Ski: Digha: ₹600/10 min, available Oct–Mar near Old Digha pier. Mandarmani: ₹500/10 min seasonal. Wear life jacket – mandatory. Age 12+ only.
Beach Activities.Parasailing: Digha seasonal (Nov–Feb only). ₹500–800 per person. Operator at New Digha end near WBTDC resort. Weather-dependent; cancelled if wind > 20 km/h.

Nature & Wildlife.Sundarbans Safari: 2-day minimum recommended. Day 1: Sajnekhali, Dobanki. Day 2: Netidhopani, Pakhiralaya. Book 4-day package ₹5000–15000/person.
Nature & Wildlife.Bird Watching: Best Nov–Feb: 300+ migratory species. Digha: flamingos near Talsari. Sundarban: kingfishers, herons, eagles. Carry 8x42 binoculars.
Nature & Wildlife.Mangrove Tours: Sundarban boat tours (3–4 hrs): spot mangrove roots, mud skippers, crocodiles, otters. Best morning slots 6–10 AM. Book via forest dept.
Nature & Wildlife.Photography Tours: Guided dawn photo safari in Sundarban: ₹2500/person. Golden hour at Mandarmani beach: 5:30–7 AM. Digha sunset: 4:30–6 PM (best Oct–Feb).

Cultural Experiences.Fishing Villages: Shankarpur fish auction: 5–7 AM. Muriganga village (Sundarban): local boat ride + fish cooking demo. Gosaba village: cycle tour ₹200.
Cultural Experiences.Temple Tours: Chandaneswar Temple (8 km from Digha): Shiva shrine, ancient carvings. Digha Mohana Kali temple. Sundarban: Bonobibi shrine at Sajnekhali.
Cultural Experiences.Local Markets: Digha: evening seafood market on Marine Drive 5–9 PM. Buy fresh pomfret, prawn, crab direct from fishermen. Bargain for best rates.
Cultural Experiences.Village Homestays: Pakhiralaya (Sundarban): ₹800–1500/night with meals, local guide. Experience mangrove life, tiger tracking stories, country boat rides.

Sundarbans Forest Permit.Cost: ₹150 (foreign nationals) | ₹40 (Indian citizens). Camera fee extra: ₹50. Video camera: ₹500. Professional photography: ₹3000.
Sundarbans Forest Permit.Processing Time: Walk-in at Sajnekhali Counter: same day if before 10 AM. Online via wbtdcl.com: 2–3 working days. Tour operators handle it for you.
Sundarbans Forest Permit.Validity: Single-entry, date-specific permit. Valid only for specified zones. Multi-zone permits need separate application. Group permit for 10+.
Sundarbans Forest Permit.Where to Apply: Forest Department Counter, Sajnekhali – open 8:30 AM–4 PM (Mon–Sat). Or pre-apply via registered tour operators. Godkhali tourist counter also issues.

Photography Permit.Cost: Professional video/film: ₹3000–10000. Drone use: ₹5000 + DGCA NOC required. Still photography (commercial): ₹1000. Personal camera: ₹50 included.
Photography Permit.Drone Use: Strict prohibition in core Sundarbans. Apply to DGCA + Forest Dept. Permission rarely granted. Confiscation if caught without permit.
Photography Permit.Processing: 7 working days minimum. Apply at District Forest Office, South 24 Parganas, Canning. Bring shoot schedule, ID, company letter.
Photography Permit.Contact: District Forest Officer, South 24 Parganas: 033-2439-XXXX. Kolkata wildlife photography clubs can advise on permit process.

Boat Safari Booking.Shared Boat: ₹500–1000 per person. Shared launches from Godkhali – 10–15 people. Fixed route (Sajnekhali–Dobanki). Daily departure 8 AM from Godkhali.
Boat Safari Booking.Private Boat: ₹3000–8000 per day. Entire boat for your group (8–15 people). Custom route. Includes Forest Guard, Life jackets. Book 1 week ahead.
Boat Safari Booking.Multi-day Tour: ₹5000–15000/person, 2–3 days including houseboat stay, all meals, guide, permits. Best operators: Help Tourism, Sundarban Tiger Camp.
Boat Safari Booking.Booking: Tourist Counter, Godkhali jetty. Or pre-book: Help Tourism 033-XXXX-XXXX, Sundarban Tiger Camp, WBTDC (wbtdcl.com). WhatsApp booking available.
